name: @rello-platform/scoring-bands
description: Canonical Home Ready scoring band vocabulary for the Rello platform — the five range-string enums (credit / income / price / down payment / monthly debt), their band-to-numeric value maps, and the shared three-outcome input validator (OK / UNRECOGNISED_BAND / INSUFFICIENT_DATA). Single source of truth shared by Rello's POST /api/scoring/calculate and HomeReady's local fallback calculator, so an unrecognised band cannot silently degrade to a default and an absent one cannot be fabricated.
